items.title: Meet Lexie!
items.excerpt: Say hello to Lexie, the Albayan Times character who appears in our stories.
items.body: Meet Lexie — a talented and intelligent student who is calm, polite, positive and fluent in speaking and writing. You'll see her in many of our Albayan Times stories!
items.author: Albayan Reporters

items.title: International Tea Day!
items.excerpt: Students explore tea traditions from around the world — a journey through culture and history.
items.body:
Let's learn about the importance of tea around the world! For International Tea Day, our reporters made a short animated story in which Lexi and her friend discover the magic of tea.

Watch the video to find out what happens when the teapot begins to glow.

items.title: Lexi learns about fasting in Ramadan
items.excerpt: A special video feature exploring the meaning and traditions of fasting during the holy month of Ramadan.
items.body: In this special video, Lexi learns about the meaning and traditions of fasting during Ramadan. From the pre-dawn meal (suhoor) to the evening meal (iftar), Lexi discovers what makes this month so special.
items.author: Albayan Reporters

items.title: Ramadan 2025 Activities
items.excerpt: Students discover supplications, kindness, and Garangao traditions during Ramadan at Albayan.
items.body: A look back at our Ramadan 2025 activities — students explored the beauty of supplications, shared acts of kindness, and celebrated Garangao with traditional songs and sweets.
